selection: Hand-reviewed, continuous three-decision excerpts from the 864 finalized provider-default episodes, chosen to illustrate behaviors in the aggregate profiles. These are qualitative examples, not matched tasks or estimates of average performance. Retained first/last frames limit available excerpts.
framePolicy: Current input is the last image in the original model input sequence. It holds during inference. Saved action snapshots are evenly spaced through the recorded action interval because exact capture timestamps are unavailable. Short 0.12-second dissolves soften transitions. Collision counts appear at phase-report boundaries. No synthesized scene frames.

models.name: Astra
models.headline: Consecutive moves, no turn or wait.
models.rationale: Illustrates its tendency to move with relatively little turning or waiting.

models.name: Sol
models.headline: Move, turn, then wait.
models.rationale: Shows the turning and explicit waiting that distinguish its aggregate action mix.

models.name: Fable
models.headline: Long moves followed by a wait.
models.rationale: Shows an explicit wait after movement, one of the behaviors in its profile.

models.name: Sonnet
models.headline: Quick responses through a busy sidewalk.
models.rationale: Shows response times close to its 4.9-second average and an excerpt with no recorded contacts.

models.name: Gemini
models.headline: A turn followed by short moves.
models.rationale: Shows a turn and shorter commanded moves, consistent with its aggregate action mix.

models.name: DeepSeek
models.headline: Contacts reported while thinking.
models.rationale: Shows long inference intervals and contacts reported during inference.

models.name: Inkling
models.headline: Three consecutive four-meter moves.
models.rationale: Shows long commanded moves that cover more distance per movement decision.

models.name: Grok
models.headline: Long inference, repeated contact reports.
models.rationale: Shows response times near its aggregate average and repeated contacts during inference.
